command:
import json,hashlib,collections; from pathlib import Path
root=Path("docs/evidence"); ledger=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/"ledger.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
assert len({e["id"] for e in ledger})==len(ledger)
for e in ledger:
 if e.get("log"): assert hashlib.sha256((root/e["log"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==e["logSHA256"],e["id"]
runs=[json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode((root/"logs"/("protected-network-native-"+i+".log")).read_text())[0] for i in ("001","002","003")]
for r in runs:
 assert r["existingResourcesPreserved"] and r["policyRestored"] and not r["existingFirewallPreserved"]
 assert r["firewallBefore"]["runtime"]==r["firewallAfter"]["runtime"]==""
 assert r["firewallBefore"]["permanent"]==r["firewallAfter"]["permanent"]==""
 assert all(n["apply"]["data"]["state"]=="succeeded" and n["packetReport"]["cleanup"]["status"]=="verified" for n in r["created"])
assert runs[0]["created"][0]["packetExitCode"]==1
assert [n["packetExitCode"] for n in runs[1]["created"]]==[0,1]
assert [n["packetExitCode"] for n in runs[2]["created"]]==[0,0]
tracker=json.loads((root/"requirements.json").read_text())["requirements"]
assert len(tracker)==71 and sum(r["status"]=="accepted" for r in tracker)==2
print(json.dumps({"ledgerEntriesChecked":len(ledger),"logHashesVerified":sum(bool(e.get("log")) for e in ledger),"scopedPacketPasses":["nat/services-only","lab/services-only","guest-only/deny"],"overallNativeRunsPassed":False,"all71StillRequired":True,"acceptedScenarios":2,"claim":"Evidence consistency only; this command performs no native test"}))
